tools.name: calculate_emi
tools.description: Loan EMI for a vehicle purchase — monthly instalment, total interest and total payable, all in rupees. Pure arithmetic, no lookup: pair it with get_on_road_price to turn a car's price into a monthly cost.

loan_amount.description: Principal in rupees (on-road price minus down payment).

tools.name: compare_vehicles
tools.description: Side-by-side spec and price comparison of 2-4 models, as rendered on the compare pages. Slugs are `make-model` (e.g. "maruti-suzuki-swift"), optionally `make-model-variant`.

city.description: City slug; defaults to the user's current city.

tools.name: get_on_road_price
tools.description: City-wise on-road price breakup for a model — ex-showroom, RTO, insurance and on-road, per variant. On-road price is city-dependent, so pass `city` whenever the user names one.

city.description: City slug, e.g. "delhi-ncr"; defaults to the user's current city.

tools.name: get_vehicle_overview
tools.description: Overview of one car or bike model: price range, Autocar rating, launch stage, headline specs and a plain-text summary. Takes the make/model slugs from search_vehicles or list_vehicles.

city.description: City slug; defaults to the user's current city.

tools.name: list_vehicles
tools.description: Browse the car/bike listing (PLP) with filters, sorting and pagination — the tool for "show me SUVs under 15 lakh" style questions. Filter slugs are backend-driven: pass include_filters=true on the first call to get the valid filter slugs and option slugs, then pass them back in `filters`.

filters.description: Facet slug -> selected option slugs, e.g. {"body_type": ["suv"]}. Discover valid keys via include_filters.

city.description: City slug; defaults to the user's current city.

sort.description: Backend sort key; omit for default ordering.

include_filters.description: Also return the available filter facets and their option slugs.

tools.name: search_vehicles
tools.description: Search Autocar India by name for cars, bikes and editorial content. Use this first to turn a user's phrasing ("swift", "thar 5 door") into the site URL and the make/model slugs the other tools need.
